Multiply a parameter in an Atlantis parameter file by a factor

edit_param_factor.Rd

Finds the parameter with grep and multiplies its value(s) by factor. Handles the two layouts used in Atlantis .prm files:

  • Single value: <name> <value> <comment> (e.g. BHalpha_FPS 2.00E+9 Alpha in Beverton-Holt). Parameters with the _T15 suffix (e.g. mum_ZS_T15) are matched too.

  • Array: <name> <n>, with the n values on the next line (e.g. mum_FPS 10).

Parameters that are not found, or found more than once, are left unchanged with a warning.

Usage

edit_param_factor(prm.lines, name, factor)

Arguments

prm.lines

Character vector of lines from an Atlantis .prm file, typically the result of readLines().

name

Character. Name of the parameter in the .prm file (e.g. "mum_FPS", "ZS_mQ", "mFC_FPS").

factor

Numeric. Factor applied to the parameter value(s).

Value

The modified prm.lines.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  bio.lines <- readLines("VMPA_setas_biol_fishing_Trunk.prm")
  bio.lines <- edit_param_factor(bio.lines, "mum_FPS", 1.2)
} # }
